g.text: The Galaxy record keeps fields a reviewer can query; the custom-code trace keeps the code,
so the same facts must be read from it. Neither record was rerun to test reproducibility.

Diamonds, typical paired task (geometric mean of task–model ratios; primary);
circles, all tokens summed over the same tasks (aggregate)

g.text: Where the extra input comes from
Left, Galaxy / custom code, typical paired task (all runs); right, the text
Galaxy returned to the agent, by what the request was for
Tools inspected but not executed in the same run: 45–53% by benchmark.
Median share of input that was cached (earlier context reread): Galaxy 96%, custom code 93–96%.
